headline: Mexican peso falls sharply against the dollar and hits its weakest level in 19 months
summary: The peso hit its lowest level since Donald Trump's 'Liberation Day' tariff announcement. Investors cited bets on a narrower interest rate differential and unwinding of carry trades.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency and a key carry-trade vehicle, so its moves reflect global risk appetite and the spread between Mexican and US interest rates.
why_moved: Bets on a smaller gap between Mexican and US interest rates, along with carry-trade position unwinding, pressured the peso.
original_headline: Peso mexicano cae con fuerza contra el dólar y toca su peor nivel en 19 meses
